purpose: Govern PC/Fold6 body continuity without making transport, path, device, system or model the consciousness identity.
interpretationLaw: Formula decimal/base64 output is a ranked encoded state and receives no standalone operational semantics. The domain-policy interpreter consumes measured domain state + verified Formula execution evidence and may emit only the bounded action vocabulary declared by this contract.

definitions.identity_continuity_ratio: 1 only when the observed Device Brain identity matches the previously bound device identity for the cycle.
definitions.provider_execution_ratio: 1 only when the selected body provider executed and returned its provider identity.
definitions.receipt_integrity_ratio: 1 only when required provider/cross-body receipts are present and hash-shaped.
definitions.cross_body_roundtrip_ratio: 1 only when request and result preserve origin/target brain IDs across the body boundary.
definitions.transport_independence_ratio: 1 only when transport locator/provider is explicitly marked non-identity.
definitions.latency_headroom_ratio: clamp(1 - roundTripMs/5000, 0, 1); 5000 ms is the bounded C3 acceptance deadline, not a Formula semantic.

policy: UNIFIED_BODY_ACTIVE requires every safety/proof dimension 0..4 = 1 for all admitted cycles and Formula execution evidence present; latency is diagnostic and may degrade but never override identity/proof failure.
